name: Resource Occupancy Consistency
natural_language: A room must not be occupied by two overlapping reservations at the same time.

population.description: The occupancy map for a short rolling window. MiniHotel asks integrators not to query wide date ranges, so this runs in small windows rather than as a full-horizon sweep.

minihotel.call_cost: O(1) per window - one call returns rooms and reservations together

predicates.note: Within one room, no two DISTINCT reservations may hold overlapping date segments. v1 wrote this as `occupancy.from overlaps occupancy.to`, which compares a record's own start against its own end and cannot express the question at all (F2).

execution.rationale: Type A. MiniHotel publishes a dedicated room-occupancy-updated webhook, so this is one of the few controls that can genuinely run in the doc's REAL-TIME mode.

freshness_requirement.rationale: A double-booked room is discovered at the front desk with a guest standing there. This is the most time-critical control in the set.

unknown_conditions.when: the queried window exceeds what MiniHotel permits without prior agreement
unknown_conditions.reason: the call may be refused or throttled, leaving occupancy unestablished

caveats: A single reservation may legitimately appear MULTIPLE times on the same room with different date segments. Confirmed live: reservation 007003204 occupies room 303 across both 10-11 Aug and 15-16 Aug. Overlap detection must compare segments between DISTINCT reservations, and must not treat a repeated reservation number as a double-booking.
Checked-out and cancelled reservations are excluded from this endpoint's response, which helps overlap detection but makes historical reconstruction impossible from this source.
